'''Pearce Naturian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked in [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa's]] [[Polis Massa medical facility/Legends|medical facility]] and reportedly an old friend of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. He remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Several months after [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] gave birth to her children, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was also present at the twins' birth, returned to the facility and met with Naturian to make sure that their secret was safe from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]] [[Malorum]] and [[Sancor]] who were trying to get evidence of Amidala's death for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
